data.selection_note: dTitle on the top row is the MAXIMUM of 32 noisy paired estimates, so it is biased upward; the +/- is this draw's Monte Carlo error and not the uncertainty on the trade being worth that. Re-run with --seed to see how far it moves before you propose anything.

trades.verdict_note: inside the selection-adjusted error for a search winner
trades.rationale: Team 03 gets Jordan Mason, Blake Corum (+0.6 pts) for Trevor Lawrence; Team 14 gets Trevor Lawrence (+7.7 pts) for Chuba Hubbard, Jaylen Waddle. You get Chuba Hubbard, Jaylen Waddle (+10.0 pts). Every side gains on its own starting lineup (weakest +0.6 playoff-weighted pts). Your title odds 6.8% -> 8.2% (+1.45pp +/- 0.48), which is inside the 3.2x standard error this ranking needs to clear once it has picked a winner out of 40 candidates -- not a significant edge. Simulated title odds fall for Team 03 (-0.95pp +/- 0.36) even though its starting lineup gains points.
caveats: a counterparty's simulated title odds FALL under this; the points gate it passed is not the same test
